subject: Is it possible that bootstrapping runs fail much more after update to 0.6-13/14?

messages.author: c64ddfc11d9098a8
messages.subject: Is it possible that bootstrapping runs fail much more after update to 0.6-13/14?
parts:
Dear all,

I was already happy with my fairly complex model, with 95% ordered observed variables (5-point likert items).

DWLS, optimization NLMINB
model parameters 318
Observations 909

CFI .985 / .958
TLI .987 / .964

RMSEA .026 / .031 / p 1.0
SRMR .044 / .044

I was happy to receive such good statistics and also the bootstrapping of 5000 samples to get the CI for direct and indirect effects went smoothly (as far as I can tell), despite the low ratio of model parameters to observations.

Then while writing up the paper I noticed a missing indirect effect, added it, and reran the model. In the meantime, I had updated to the new version of lavaan 0.6-13 and now 0.6-14. Since then my bootstrapping fails at least 30-50% of the time, which suggests overfitting I guess. 

I am now wondering if 
a) It might also have something to do with the update and discovered bug in the versions < 0.6-13
b) I just didn't notice the high number of failed bootstrapping runs all the time (I have verbose=TRUE on) and look always for the first runs.
c) Since also with using a summary score instead of some latent variables and going to a number of model paramaters of below 200, I cannot get boostrapping to work. Which makes me wonder if I have something wrong in my bootstrapping code:

fit_SEM99b <- sem(data = df_NPs, model = SEM99, estimator="DWLS", se="bootstrap", bootstrap=10, verbose=T, parallel="yes", ordered = c("var1","var2","var3",... ))  
summary(fit_SEM99b, fit.measures=T, standardized=T,  rsquare=T)
parameterEstimates(fit_SEM99b, boot.ci.type="bca.simple")

Thanks in advance for any help to get me out of my rabbit hole. 

Marcel
